slices.title: Freeze catalogue source inventory
slices.summary: Frozen the pre-change catalogue source map. The baseline distinguishes 33 concrete assets and 10 lazy packs from 50 descriptors, 34 Workbench identities, 41 display rows, 69 Workbench relationships, and 82 display representations. It records concrete identity/loading, mixed projection, adapter, route, and review-capture ownership; preserves all existing routes; and fixes the next boundary at one row per concrete loadable ID without changing runtime or visual behavior. Focused 21/21, full 3130/3130, typecheck, build, promotion memory, diff hygiene, and workspace validation pass.

slices.title: Characterize loadable asset registry
slices.summary: Added a compact typed loadable registry that groups the generated editor metadata by concrete animation ID, requires one exact asset-level descriptor, records one lazy pack owner, and carries no renderer, representation, lifecycle, or roadmap state. Characterization proves one entry for each of the 33 concrete assets, successful resolution across all 10 packs, and exclusion of seven reader-only playable display IDs plus the planned quadratic identity. Eight focused tests, full typecheck, architecture, diff hygiene, and workspace validation pass; no runtime consumer or visual behavior changed.

slices.title: Separate concrete from planned identities
slices.summary: Catalogue membership now equals the 33 lazy-loadable concrete identities exactly; the one planned quadratic identity remains immutable context outside catalogue rows, and projection drift fails closed without mutating caller-owned records.

slices.title: Map surface adapter hostability
slices.summary: Added a read-only hostability seam that distinguishes target dispatch from actual adapter resolution. The current 33-asset map is 31 ready, 2 missing-adapter, and 0 unsupported-surface: programming.add and the synchronized equation/programming comparison lack a programming adapter. Generic and specialized priority ownership remains intact; no renderer, loader, runtime, or visual behavior changed.

slices.title: Map related context sprawl
slices.summary: Frozen the related-context map: 33 concrete assets currently fan out to 50 descriptors, 69 Workbench relationships, and 74 concrete display contexts (52 editor, 17 card, 3 reader, 2 diagnostic). Solve-x is widest at seven contexts. Seven reader-only playable display IDs remain preserved route evidence but cannot mint catalogue rows. Generated display metadata is the runtime context source; source-rich Workbench control, review, roadmap, and promotion state stays outside catalogue membership.

slices.title: Build asset-first catalogue projection
slices.summary: Built the lightweight asset-first projection: each loadable registry member receives primary metadata, pack identity, explicit domains/families/samples, honest tags, separate fuzzy-search terms, and exact-ID related contexts. Planned and display-only playable identities cannot enter. The runtime projection imports generated metadata only and carries no Workbench, project-control, promotion, hostability, adapter, renderer, or asset-pack implementation state.

slices.title: Prove one row per concrete asset
slices.summary: Proved the catalogue cardinality law: 33 unique projected row IDs exactly equal the 33 loadable registry IDs and the 33 assets resolved from their exact packs. The 50 descriptors and 74 globally unique related contexts remain subordinate metadata, and duplicate loadable membership fails before a row can render.

slices.title: Derive honest catalogue health
slices.summary: Derived honest catalogue health from adapter hostability, observed paint, diagnostics, and explicit review need: the pre-host baseline is 0 Ready, 31 Review, and 2 Broken, independent from promotion and reviewer disposition.

slices.title: Add stable catalogue visual command
slices.summary: Added stable npm run visual:animation-catalogue backed by a repo-owned Chromium capture script. It records the current solve-x Workbench bootstrap at the desktop review viewport to disposable tmp/codex output, providing an inspected before-state that later shell slices can tighten without changing the command.

slices.title: Establish default catalogue route
slices.summary: Made the asset catalogue the canonical empty-query route with an explicit animation-catalogue alias. The editor, Workbench, library host, and tutorial remain preserved explicit views; returning to the editor now writes view=editor rather than colliding with the new default. The temporary catalogue render is intentionally minimal and contains no old dashboard machinery.
